clauses.title: Scope – Requirements of
clauses.text: 1. Scope -  Requirements of low carbon steel plates, sections, flats, bars, etc. for general structural purposes in the tensile range of 290 to 470 MPa.

clauses.title: The steels are equally
clauses.text: 1.1 The steels are equally suitable for bolted and riveted structures and for general engineering purposes.

clauses.title: When welding is employed
clauses.text: 1.2 When welding is employed for fabrication and guranteed weldability is required, welding procedure should be as specified in  IS 9595 : 1996. Metal-arc welding of carbon and carbon manganese steels  (first revision)'.

clauses.title: Grades – These shall
clauses.text: 2. Grades -   These shall   be   three     Grades - Fe 290, Fe 330, and Fe 370.

clauses.title: Freedom from Defects
clauses.text: 3. Freedom from Defects  - The finished material shall be reasonably free from surface flaws; laminations; rough/jagged and imperfect edges; and all other harmful defects.

clauses.title: Minor surface defects may
clauses.text: 3.1 Minor surface defects may be removed by grinding provided the thickness is not reduced locally by more than 4 percent below the minimum specified thickness.

clauses.title: Bend Test – For
clauses.text: 6. Bend Test -  For bend test, the test piece at room temperature shall withstand bending through 1800 to an internal diameter not greater than that given in Table 2 without cracking.

clauses.title: Dimensions– Nominal dimensions of rolled
clauses.text: 7. Dimensions- Nominal dimensions of rolled products conforming to this specification shall be in accordance with the relevant Indian Standard . Currently available Indian Standards are listed in Table 4 of the standard.

clauses.title: Tolerances – Rolling and
clauses.text: 8. Tolerances - Rolling and cutting tolerances for steel products conforming to this standard shall be those specified in IS 1852 : 1985 ++. ++ Rolling and cutting tolerances for hot rolled steel products (fourth revision).
